rank_chart.pivot: maximum absolute determinant r-by-r submatrix of the full mean; lexicographic first on an exact tie
rank_chart.residual: complete Schur complement S-R P^-1 Q
rank_chart.scope: vanishing determinantal constraints, with no diagonalizability or exponential-root assumption
rank_chart.deleted_batches: the full-mean pivot is held fixed through all 400 delete-one residuals

covariance_score.covariance: full delete-one jackknife covariance of every real and imaginary Schur coordinate

flat_extension_contract.order1: rank H_degree2 <=3 is the available rank(H2)=rank(H1) plateau test
flat_extension_contract.order2: not observable without moments through total degree six
flat_extension_contract.ordered_path: not observable because raw rows store only endpoint G(a,b), not separate xy and yx histories

decision_rule: the lower bound is one plus the largest rejected rank null; shared rank<=5 rejection yields common-state dimension at least six
